hero.headline: A Clear Path to 3MW Capacity
hero.subheadline: We follow a de-risked, phased approach that allows for immediate revenue generation while scaling to meet global demand.

sections.title: Phased Scaling for Maximum Stability
sections.body: Our roadmap is designed to minimize risk and maximize early ROI. We begin with Phase 1, a 300kW IT load cluster that serves as our proof of concept for local operations and DePIN integration. By using modular containerized units, we can go from ground-breaking to full operation within 9-12 months. Phase 2 scales this success to 1MW, reaching our target EBITDA of 35-50% through improved operational efficiency and larger-scale GPU clusters. Finally, Phase 3 takes us beyond the 3MW mark, where we transition into permanent structures and explore replication across other energy-rich regions in East Africa. This methodical progression ensures that we learn from each phase, optimizing our PUE and hardware mix as the AI market evolves. Additional context: the project follows a clear rollout roadmap that aligns low-cost energy, infrastructure reliability, and flexible deployment models. Each phase includes checkpoints on capacity, uptime, and unit economics so stakeholders can track progress with confide

sections.title: Key Milestones
items: 2024: Feasibility studies, site selection, and initial technical design completed.
2025: Ground-breaking and completion of Phase 1 (300kW) with immediate DePIN onboarding.
2026: Expansion to Phase 2 (1MW), achieving full operational profitability.
2027: Planning and infrastructure preparation for Phase 3 (3MW+).
2028+: Replication of the model in neighboring East African jurisdictions.
